obs: “The section then goes on to say that, "in addition to such fine, such merchandise shall be forfeited." The sole meaning of this is, that the person owning the merchandise shall lose it by forfeiture, in addition to such possible loss as may come to him by the imposition … of the pecuniary fine”
“Congress provided that the new penalties shall be in addition to any other provisions of title 17 or any other law. 18 U. S. C. 2319(a) (emphasis added).”
